themes.name: Daybreak
themes.author: StoryLark
themes.description: StoryLark's own face — warm paper instead of stark white, a dawn-teal accent, a gold "birdsong" read-along highlight, and a literary reading serif. Ships as the default theme in every StoryLark build.
themes.install: Copy brands/storylark to brands/<your-id> and retune the tokens in theme.css.

themes.name: Gunner the Lab
themes.author: Gunner the Lab
themes.description: A warm storybook palette from a real StoryLark-powered reader: cream pages, pumpkin-orange accents, forest-green links, and a cozy charcoal dark mode. A great example of matching a theme 1:1 to an existing site's identity.
themes.install: Copy themes/gunner-the-lab from this repo into your build's brands/ directory.

themes.name: Holdfast Press
themes.author: Holdfast Press
themes.description: A dark-first literary identity: deep stone surfaces, bone-white text, a rare ember accent, and a four-face type system (Cormorant Garamond display, Cinzel headers, Lora body). Shows how far the token contract can carry a mood — including a defaultTheme of dark.
themes.fonts: Cormorant Garamond · Cinzel · Lora · IBM Plex Mono
themes.install: Copy themes/hold-fast-press from this repo into your build's brands/ directory.

templates.name: Classic Library
templates.author: StoryLark
templates.description: The default presentation: a flat library of stories with Home, Library, word-synced Reader, Now Playing, and Settings screens. Read, Listen, or Read + Listen per story, offline downloads, and install-to-home-screen built in.
templates.install: The base build ships this template; set layout: "flat" in brand.json.
